resources.string: The AI agent of your NAS on your phone: ask, speak, approve – with the rights of your account.
The NAS no longer knows this phone (ended or expired). Please pair again.

The Agent app talks to your NAS at home directly and takes over the pairing of the TitanOS app in the background. That is why Android asks whether the app may reach devices on the local network. Without this permission it cannot find the NAS on your home network, and pairing through the TitanOS app fails without a message.
The app only uses the permission for the connection to your NAS. You can change it at any time in the app’s Android settings.
